mapper.sql: partner_id, partner_code, partner_name, partner_name_kana, is_customer AS customer, is_supplier AS supplier, postal_code, address, tel, fax, contact_name, closing_day, payment_month_offset, payment_day, enabled, version
mapper.select: SELECT partner_id, partner_code, partner_name, (enabled AND is_supplier) AS selectable FROM m_partner WHERE (enabled AND is_supplier) OR partner_id = #{includeId} ORDER BY partner_code
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_partner WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId} AND enabled AND is_supplier)

where.if: AND (partner_code LIKE #{c.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR partner_name LIKE #{c.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR partner_name_kana LIKE #{c.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM m_partner
ORDER BY partner_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_partner WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO m_partner ( partner_code, partner_name, partner_name_kana, is_customer, is_supplier, postal_code, address, tel, fax, contact_name, closing_day, payment_month_offset, payment_day, enabled, version, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{p.partnerCode}, #{p.partnerName}, #{p.partnerNameKana}, #{p.customer}, #{p.supplier}, #{p.postalCode}, #{p.address}, #{p.tel}, #{p.fax}, #{p.contactName}, #{p.closingDay}, #{p.paymentMonthOffset}, #{p.paymentDay}, #{p.enabled}, 0, #{now}, #{operatorId}, #{now}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE m_partner SET partner_name = #{p.partnerName}, partner_name_kana = #{p.partnerNameKana}, is_customer = #{p.customer}, is_supplier = #{p.supplier}, postal_code = #{p.postalCode}, address = #{p.address}, tel = #{p.tel}, fax = #{p.fax}, contact_name = #{p.contactName}, closing_day = #{p.closingDay}, payment_month_offset = #{p.paymentMonthOffset}, payment_day = #{p.paymentDay}, enabled = #{p.enabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{operatorId} WHERE partner_id = #{p.partnerId} AND version = #{p.version}
